title: Hunting Trees
hook: Player-safe note: Walking predatory trees with root legs, hooked branch arms, hollow amber eyes, and bark faces that make ordinary forest scenery feel like it might choose a target.

blocks.label: Observed Form
blocks.body: Predatory walking trees with root legs lifting from the soil, hooked branch arms, moss, lichen, and hollow amber eyes in bark faces.

blocks.label: Behavior
blocks.body: The point where the forest stops being scenery and starts being hungry. They do not hate; they harvest, the way a snare does. The horror is that they only move when you stop watching.

blocks.label: Warning Signs
blocks.body: Fire, the cleared light of the open road, and prey that refuses to scatter.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.
Read posture, tracks, and what it is protecting.
